summary.root_cause_text: Order worker got stuck in a wait state and stopped consuming the queue. The deeper trigger is unknown; config and recent deploys look normal.
recommended: Find out why the worker entered the wait state and never resumed, for example a missing wakeup or lock. Add an alert on processed not advancing while queue depth grows.

root_causes: Order worker got stuck in a wait state and stopped consuming the queue. The deeper trigger is unknown; config and recent deploys look normal.
evidence: queue_depth grew 26 -> 36 while processed stayed at 14 of 50 enqueued
Log: 'worker entered wait state' (DEBUG), with no further worker activity
Config is sane (internal://payments-v1, worker_count 1, queue_max 1000). The last change, v1.3, was 22.6h ago, which doesn't match the incident timing.
args.impact: The queue backed up to 36 orders (total_sar 19257.49 queued at peak) with no orders lost or unpaid. After the restart, all 73 orders were processed and 73 payments recorded, with queue depth 0.
recommended_actions: Find out why the worker entered the wait state and never resumed, for example a missing wakeup or lock. Add an alert on processed not advancing while queue depth grows.
args.summary: The worker stalled while the API kept enqueuing orders, and /health stayed green. Restarting the worker drained the queue, with every order paid and no integrity failures. check_invariants is green. The reason the worker stalled is still unknown and needs follow-up.
